events.detail: 7 current official Auction House Scotland listings with explicit planning permission or permission in principle were captured for the 27 August 2026 auction.
Exact title and address repository searches returned no indexed match for all 7 wave-42 candidates.
Seven permission or PPP rows were separated; two older permissions remain explicitly gated for validity and implementation evidence.
Wave-42 permission-backed rows were published with HTTP SHA256, parcel and geometry promotion gates preserved.
3 current official listings covering STPP, previous applications or unconfirmed conversion consent were captured.
Exact title and address repository searches returned no indexed match for all 3 wave-43 candidates.
STPP, unfinished-conversion and previous-application rows were quarantined from implementable-permission candidates; two warnings remain visible.
Wave-43 rows were published with current-permission and product-promotion gates preserved.
